lead: 今天的目標：在 stand-up 上用 30 秒把進度、卡點、時程講清楚，不繞路、不過度客氣。請把每個 speaking 段落真的出聲唸出來，先講再看解答。

phrases.gl: 照計畫進行、時程沒問題
phrases.ex: We're on track for the Friday drop — calibration is done on four of the five camera positions.

phrases.gl: 我被卡住了，卡在某件事上（直接、專業，不是抱怨）
phrases.ex: I'm blocked on the vehicle team's rig schedule — I can't kick off the night-time collection runs until they confirm a slot.

phrases.en: To unblock this, I need X by Y.
phrases.gl: 要解卡，我需要什麼、什麼時候要
phrases.ex: To unblock this, I need the updated intrinsics from the hardware team by Wednesday morning.

phrases.gl: 上次同步之後（開場交代進度的乾淨起手式）
phrases.ex: Since we last spoke, we've labeled another 12k frames and retrained the detector.

phrases.en: To give you the headline first…
phrases.gl: 先講結論（把重點前置，別鋪陳）
phrases.ex: To give you the headline first: accuracy is up two points, but recall on pedestrians at night still isn't where we need it.

phrases.en: I'd put that at about two weeks, assuming…
phrases.gl: 估時程並附上前提（保護自己又不含糊）
phrases.ex: I'd put that at about two weeks, assuming we get the second test vehicle.

phrases.gl: 我的判斷是……（有立場但不僵硬，聽起來像 PM 而不是不確定）
phrases.ex: My read is the drop in accuracy comes from the lens change, not the model.

phrases.gl: 這個會後單獨談，別佔用全體時間
phrases.ex: That's a deeper hardware question — let me take that offline with Kevin after this.
phrases.fix: 取代 "We can discuss about it later"

setup: Setup. It's Monday stand-up for the ADAS perception sprint. Last week you ran three daytime data collection sessions, but Saturday's night-time run was cancelled because one of the side cameras lost sync mid-drive. Your model retrain is finished, but you can't validate night performance without that data. The program manager, David, is on the call and cares mainly about whether the milestone review on the 14th is still safe.

prompts.q: “Momo, can you give us your update?” — 30 seconds, no rambling.
prompts.frame: Headline → what shipped → what didn't → what's next.
prompts.say: 先出聲講完整段，再展開下面的 model answer。
prompts.model: “Sure. Headline: we're on track for the retrain, but night-time validation has slipped by a few days. Since Thursday we've completed three daytime collection runs and finished retraining the detector — daytime mAP is up about two points. The Saturday night run got cancelled because the left side camera dropped sync roughly twenty minutes in, so we have no usable night data yet. This week I'm re-booking that run and validating the model on whatever night footage we already have.”

prompts.q: David: “So is the review on the 14th at risk?”
prompts.frame: Give a clear position → the condition it depends on → what you need from him.
prompts.model: “Not yet, but it's tight. My read is we can still make the 14th if we get one clean night run this week — that gives us three days to process and validate. If the run slips past Thursday, I'd rather flag it now than promise the date. What would help is if you can push the vehicle team to give us a fixed slot rather than a standby slot.”

prompts.q: A hardware engineer jumps in and starts explaining sync timing at register level. Redirect without being rude, then close your update.
prompts.frame: Acknowledge the value → defer it → hand back / close.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「禮貌但堅定地把話收回來」。
prompts.model: “That's useful, and I do want the detail — let me take that offline with you right after this so we don't hold up the room. For stand-up purposes: one blocker, the night run, and I'll have a confirmed slot by end of day tomorrow. That's it from me.”

fixes.bad: Last week we discuss about the camera issue with vehicle team.
fixes.good: Last week we discussed the camera issue with the vehicle team.
fixes.note: Grammar：discuss 後面不接 about；team 前面要 the。

fixes.bad: The model accuracy is very very good, I think maybe we can close this task.
fixes.good: Accuracy looks strong. My read is we can close this task.
fixes.note: Register + directness：疊字 "very very" 聽起來不專業；"I think maybe" 讓你的判斷失去重量。

fixes.bad: I will send you the data yesterday, sorry for that.
fixes.good: I should have sent you the data on Friday — you'll have it within the hour.
fixes.note: Tense：過去的疏漏用 should have + p.p.；並且用行動收尾，而不是只道歉。

fixes.bad: Because of some reason, the collection run is not so smooth, maybe we need to consider re-plan.
fixes.good: The collection run was cut short: one camera lost sync. I'd like to re-book it for Wednesday.
fixes.note: Vagueness：說明具體原因，並提出明確方案，不要用 "some reason" / "maybe we need to consider"。

fixes.bad: Please kindly help me to confirm the schedule ASAP, thanks a lot.
fixes.good: Could you confirm the slot by tomorrow morning? I need it to lock the run.
fixes.note: Register：kindly help me / ASAP 是亞洲商業信件慣性；native 用具體時間 + 原因，反而更有效也更禮貌。

challenge:
今天在真實會議中做這一件事：把你的 stand-up update 用「headline first」開場，而且明確講一次 “I'm blocked on… To unblock this, I need … by …”。

  • 如果今天沒有英文會議 → 用手機錄一段 60 秒的 monologue：主題是「上週的 data collection 進度與這週的一個 blocker」，開頭必須是 “To give you the headline first…”。
  • 錄完聽一次，只檢查一件事：有沒有出現 “I think maybe”。有的話，重錄一次換成 “My read is”。
check: 我今天有沒有在 30 秒內講完一段 update，而且結論放在最前面？
我有沒有講出一個 blocker，並且同時說出「我需要誰、在什麼時間前、給我什麼」？
今天我有成功用 “My read is…” 取代 “I think maybe…” 至少一次嗎？
